data.quality_policy: fail on corrupt ZIP, invalid row, duplicate timestamp, non-contiguous 5m series, missing required archive or missing signal/entry/exit bar

signal.event_clock: actual realized funding event timestamps; realized rate magnitude is not used as a signal
signal.premium_observation: close of the completed premium-index 5m bar ending immediately before the funding event
signal.zscore_method: current premium minus mean of the prior 90 valid event premiums, divided by their sample standard deviation
signal.direction: positive premium short; negative premium long
signal.decision_time: last millisecond before the funding event, after the pre-event premium bar closes
signal.entry_time: contract 5m open exactly 5 minutes after settlement
signal.exit_time: contract 5m open exactly 65 minutes after settlement
signal.overlap: at most one open trade per symbol

execution.fees: each leg charged on its own simulated fill notional
execution.funding: charge every realized event at event mark-price proxy when entry_time <= event_time < exit_time

interpretation.pass: eligible only for a broader point-in-time-universe development test with a preregistered non-funding-event placebo
interpretation.fail: eliminate this exact specification; any threshold, delay or holding-period change requires a new experiment id
